name: Casey
source: Casey’s cheerful and energetic, if not a bit timid at times. He has a skill for agility, balance, and being an overall cinnamon roll. An eternal optimist, he makes the best out of any situation. He’s sweet and supportive of his childhood friend, Catalina, but is hiding something dark from even her.
